title: Slow Query Regression in User Service After Index Drop
description: A deployment accidentally dropped a critical index on the users.email column. Queries filtering by email (login, password reset) went from 5ms to 30s, causing cascade timeouts in auth-service.

evidence_catalog.summary: Query latency for 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?' increased from p99 5ms to 30s
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT quantile(0.99)(db_query_duration_seconds) FROM db_queries WHERE query_name='select_by_email'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate query latency metrics showing regression

evidence_catalog.summary: PostgreSQL slow query log shows seq scan on users table for email filter (rows=2.5M, cost=150000)
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM pg_slow_log WHERE query LIKE '%email%' AND duration > 10000
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate PostgreSQL slow query log entries

evidence_catalog.summary: Deployment deploy-791 ran database migration that dropped idx_users_email index
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create deployment with migration script

evidence_catalog.summary: Commit added migration to drop 'unused' idx_users_email index (mistakenly marked unused)
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create commit with migration SQL

evidence_catalog.summary: 7-day baseline for select_by_email query: p50=3ms, p95=8ms, p99=12ms
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM query_baselines WHERE service='user-service' AND query='select_by_email'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will compute baseline from historical metrics

causal_chain.from_description: Migration dropped idx_users_email index during deployment
causal_chain.to_description: Queries on users.email forced to sequential scan 2.5M rows

causal_chain.from_description: Sequential scan takes 30s vs 5ms with index
causal_chain.to_description: Login and password reset queries timeout

causal_chain.from_description: Auth service calls to user-service timeout
causal_chain.to_description: Users unable to login or reset passwords

contributing_factors: No migration review for index drops
Missing query performance test in CI

misleading_or_confounding_signals: User service CPU high (symptom of seq scan, not cause)
Auth service errors (downstream, not root cause)

required_checks.description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on affected query
required_checks.expected_outcome: Shows Seq Scan instead of Index Scan

required_checks.description: Check migration script for DROP INDEX

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Recreate idx_users_email index on users.email column
test_plan: Verify query latency returns to baseline
remediation_guidance.rollback_plan: Index creation is additive; no rollback needed if issues arise
